author: fabiocos
body:
#### PR description:

Effective protection to (partially) solve issue https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/52431 .
```BTLReadoutMap``` is not defined for geometry scenarios previous than v4. In https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51861 this map is used in ```BTLElectronicsSim``` to produce the new DIGI collection. If no protection is present, the results are inconsistent as numbering scheme, and produce failures downstream.

A check forces the filling of the new DIGI collection only for the supported scenarios.

#### PR validation:

wfs. 38434.0 (D128, supported) and 29634.0 (D110, not supported) both runs succesfully.
title: MTD digitization: add a protection in BTL digitization against using BTLReadoutMap for unsupported scenarios
